description: Bounded exclusion of EP2 over the searched atlas domain. The bound is on the scale-free root separation |a1/a2| and on the pairwise branch gap; it is NOT based on |dF/domega|, which is not invariant under rescaling of the spectral condition and therefore cannot bound anything.

WITHDRAWN.min_root_separation: WITHDRAWN. |a1/a2| measures the distance to the nearest zero OR POLE; Leaver's CF is meromorphic and the contour integral returns zeros-minus-poles = 0 out to radius 0.20, so the quoted value was a pole distance. See docs/FAILED_APPROACHES.md.
WITHDRAWN.min_abs_discriminant: WITHDRAWN as independent. D = (w+ - w-)^2 is the square of the gap (0.5116^2 = 0.26176); one quantity reported twice.
